title: Contrix Audit RYW Receipt
description: Read-Your-Writes receipt issued by an Events API node, witness, or peer Principal Server confirming that a cx.audit.accessed envelope has reached accepted state. Required by cx.profile.attested_audit.e2ee.v1 and cx.profile.disclosed_audit.e2ee.v1 before the Audit Agent is allowed to release plaintext (see zh/crypto-media/audited-e2ee.md §4.1). The audit_assurance_class field MUST match the Realm-declared audit_assurance value; mismatch fail closed.

trust_domain.description: Deployment trust domain for the Realm at the receipt frontier. Verifiers MUST require this to match the current receive context and the enclosing audit Event Realm context before using audit_policy_version_digest.

kind.description: Attestation kind derived from witnesses[]. 'federation_witness_attested' MUST be used iff witnesses[] contains >= 2 distinct entries (distinct issuer.did AND distinct controlling_organization AND distinct verification_method) AND each issuer.did is listed by Realm policy under audit.ryw_witnesses[]. 'single_source' MUST be used iff witnesses[] contains exactly 1 entry. Any mismatch between 'kind' and the witnesses[] cardinality / distinctness / Realm policy listing MUST be rejected with audit_receipt_invalidated. The value is externally verifiable from the witness list, not a self-claim.

issuer.description: Service DID of the witness that produced this receipt.

verification_method.description: DID URL of the key the witness used to sign (e.g. did:web:...#key-1). MUST be distinct from other witnesses' verification_method values for 'federation_witness_attested' to be valid.

controlling_organization.description: DID of the organization that controls the witness. This value is not self-attested: verifiers MUST resolve issuer DID Document and confirm its controller / service ownership chain matches controlling_organization. For 'federation_witness_attested', all witnesses' controlling_organization values MUST be pairwise distinct and MUST NOT equal the audit actor's controlling organization.

attested_at.description: Time at which this witness attested. Receivers MAY use the latest attested_at across witnesses as the effective receipt timestamp.

witnesses.description: Externally verifiable list of witnesses attesting that the audit_event_id+audit_event_digest reached accepted state. The 'kind' field MUST be derivable from this list per the rules in §4.1.1.

witness_attestation.description: Witness attestation block. The receipt's independence is externally verifiable from the witnesses[] list rather than self-claimed via a single enum. See zh/crypto-media/audited-e2ee.md §4.1 / §4.1.1.

audit_assurance_class.description: Audit assurance class propagated from the Realm audit_assurance policy field. attested_hardware = cx.profile.attested_audit.e2ee.v1 (TEE/HSM/enclave attestation required). disclosed_policy = cx.profile.disclosed_audit.e2ee.v1 (process-only disclosure, NOT cryptographically enforced). Audit Agents MUST propagate the Realm-declared value verbatim; receivers MUST fail closed when this field disagrees with the Realm audit_assurance at the receipt's frontier.

audit_policy_version_digest.description: Canonical hash of the Realm-bound audit policy tuple from cx.realm.policy_components at the receipt's frontier. Computed as fixed sha256 over canonical JSON {realm_id: <id>, trust_domain: <trust_domain>, audit_disclosure: <object>, audit_assurance: <string>}. Lets verifiers atomically check 'receipt's claim matches Realm-declared policy at this frontier' without replaying events and prevents cross-Realm reuse of identical policy text. MUST match the receipt frontier's policy state; mismatch MUST fail closed (audit_receipt_invalidated). Required field — missing receipts MUST be rejected to prevent silent policy drift. This field is intentionally not hash-agile in v1; a future algorithm change requires a new schema/profile.

recovery_reason_code.description: Optional machine-readable code, set only when this RYW receipt covers a cx.audit.accessed Event emitted via the Late Key Recovery path (see zh/crypto-media/encryption-and-audit.md §2.3.5 and zh/crypto-media/audited-e2ee.md §4.1). Payload value, not an error-code-registry reason_code. Used by audit projections to distinguish late-key-triggered accesses from first-access reads. When absent, the receipt covers a normal (first-access) cx.audit.accessed Event.
